questions.prompt: 15Which of the following is an example of energy efficiency (as opposed to reducing consumption)
options: Only having the TV or the ipad on, not both
Having insulation installed in a house
Turning the lights off when leaving a room
questions.explanation: Insulation can reduce energy needed for the same thermal comfort. Turning off unused devices mainly reduces consumption.

questions.prompt: 16Energy can not be created or destroyed.  This is known as
options: The Law of conservation of energy
questions.explanation: The law of conservation of energy: energy is transferred/transformed rather than created or destroyed in the intended closed-system model.
